File Notes

What does the %PDF-1.7 header mean?

Every PDF file begins with a header line such as %PDF-1.7. The line names the version of the format that the file claims to follow, and it is the first thing a reader checks before it jumps to the cross-reference table near the end of the file.

Some files carry a few junk bytes before the header. Most readers search the first kilobyte for it, which is why a page that only talks about the header must not be mistaken for a PDF itself.
